scope: Integrated local application; acceptance inputs are synthetic and do not approve Maple Avenue factual or editorial claims.

checks.context: Fresh disposable checkout with actual workspace links; installation followed by checks, production build, and start/save/stop smoke test.

checks.note: Suite counts overlap; they are not a unique-test total. Lint, TypeScript, Vue scripts/templates, and documentation links also passed.

checks.environment: GSTORY_CHROME points to the installed sandboxed browser; machine-specific environment file is untracked.
GSTORY_CHROME and GSTORY_REMOTION_BUNDLE point to the local browser and already built fixture bundle.

checks.scope: Complete integrated diff including final formatting and documentation

flows: edit scenes and both camera formats
edit roadway bands and direction markings
browserWalkthrough.visualReview: Agent inspected synthetic editor and exported stills; final human production playback review is not claimed.

source.checkoutNote: Working-tree hashes retain Windows checkout line endings. Where committed bytes differ only by CRLF/LF, both hashes are recorded. All normalized source bytes match the implementation commit.

limitations: Windows x64 was exercised; other operating systems and GPUs are unverified.
Render resource profile supports retained GeoJSON, inline styles, and local font assets. Remote tiles, sprites, glyph services, aerial compositing, and local routing are unavailable.
Project documents and geographic imports have explicit size and feature limits; these checks do not establish unlimited project capacity.
Research uses retained inputs and explicit reviews. Historical comparisons require compatible periods; spatial aggregation of medians is rejected.
Actual Maple geography, network evidence, dimensions, publication rights, factual review, editorial approval, and final human playback review remain missing.
No individual issue closure, controller activation, merge, or production milestone acceptance is included.
productionReadiness: Maple Avenue production inputs and named approvals remain incomplete
